text: Entry 881 stops caching mime2DecodedAuthor and mime2DecodedRecipients for MessageHeader conversion. An RFC 2047 encoded display name can contain a comma that requires quoting after decoding. parseEncodedAddrHeader passes the encoded header to parseEncodedHeaderW and rebuilds each mailbox with makeMimeAddress. The UTF-8 fixture verifies one quoted Hörst, Kenny author and two recipient mailboxes; NNTP expects no recipients. Current getFull expectations also contain quotes, unlike the original landing’s decoded header expectations. Manual representation proposal: name encoded header text, parsed addresses and display mailbox strings distinctly, and assert comma-containing names plus recipient boundaries. Query matching uses a separate isAddressMatch implementation; the conversion test does not prove every query path preserves the same grammar.
title: Parse encoded mailbox syntax before creating a decoded display mailbox
